text: With the focus of the Clan, ragwort, wild garlic, moss clumps, oak leaf bundles, daisies, horsetail clumps, doses of poppy seeds, mullein, elder leaf bundles, marigold, plantain bundles, dandelions, juniper bunches, tansy, and cobwebs were gathered.
Yewstar quickly apologizes after bumping into Reedheart. They have a small laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Yewstar thinks Bouncepelt was nice to him today. (low positive effect)
Prancelaurel is sharing the latest gossip she heard over the border with Mallowpelt. (medium positive effect)
None of Pearpelt, Warmswirl, Mossflight, or Erminedaisy's critiques about her usage of authority matter to Prancelaurel. (negative effect)
Prancelaurel and Peakspore gossip about drama nobody else knows. (high positive effect)
Craneflight notices one of her friends laughing with Amberfur. (low negative effect)
Bushberry thanked Craneflight for bringing him food. (low positive effect)
Reedheart doesn't want to apologize to Primfreckle for something. (medium negative effect)
Primfreckle is proud of how productive and attentive Gentlepaw, Shimmerpaw, Daisypaw, and Dancingpaw are during a lesson about poisonous plants. (positive effect)
Primfreckle and Pebblechase sunbathe together. (low positive effect)
Olivebranch follows through on a small promise made with Peatcrest. (low positive effect)
Peatcrest just told Diablofoot a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Algaepool thanked Carptail for bringing him food. (low positive effect)
Carptail, Auburnsplash, and Cobaltstrike had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Carptail finds peace in Stoatshade's company when it can't be found anywhere else. (high positive effect)
Saffronfoot saw Paellapad show off a skill he never knew she had. (high positive effect)
While Saffronfoot and Suntooth are talking, Saffronfoot gets the feeling that he can trust Suntooth, and confesses that he likes Prancelaurel. (positive effect)
When Saffronfoot and Suntooth realize they've been grooming their pelts the same way, they laugh about it. (low positive effect)
Oddmuzzle tells his Clanmates that something's off about Pebblechase. (medium negative effect)
After a heated argument about herbs, Oddmuzzle, Peatcrest, Heavythud, Saffronfoot, and Primfreckle avoid each other. (negative effect)
Oddmuzzle asks Diablofoot how she's doing. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart listens to Mossflight's big plans for the day. (low positive effect)
Hollyheart confronted Shinefur about her bad attitude but that only makes Shinefur act out more. (medium negative effect)
Pigeonbloom keeps pacing around the clearing late at night and Heavythud is the only one who notices. (high negative effect)
Hushshimmer pulled an embarrassing prank on Heavythud's friend. (low negative effect)
Flutterpaw's soreness is gone.

With the stars softly shining and lighting their pelts, Carptail gives Flutterpaw his full name of Flutterfeather. They both share the rest of the night with StarClan, celebrating their good fortune in having another medicine cat.
Flutterfeather dispels a bad rumor about Carptail. (high positive effect)
After the Gathering, Flutterfeather notices that Mallowpelt is making sure everyone got home. (low positive effect)
After Suntooth finished her food, Saltpaw noticed she made a mess. (medium negative effect)
Saltpaw makes up a new Clan with Pheasantbrush. (medium positive effect)
Warmswirl brought Olivebranch some dry bedding. (low positive effect)
Daisypaw, Dancingpaw, Saltpaw, and Shimmerpaw bemoan Olivebranch's insistence that they get up and do stretches at dawn. While they do it, nobody but Olivebranch likes it. (negative effect)
Olivebranch and Mosscrackle take turns in a small patch of sunlight. (medium positive effect)
m_c will always love r_c, but has decided to move on.
Primfreckle knows secrets about Duckbelly that he hasn't told anyone else. (high positive effect)
Duckbelly, Poolleaf, and Mallowpelt took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Duckbelly includes Petalglow in a conversation that Petalglow struggled to join. (low positive effect)
Curryfoot doesn't tell Brindletooth that they forgot to groom a part of their fur. (low negative effect)
Curryfoot has been spending time with Petalglow lately. (low positive effect)
Tomatofreckle's Clanmates notice that she talks a lot about Duckbelly. (high positive effect)
Tomatofreckle overhears Kamautail humming a comforting tune. (low positive effect)
Kamautail is prancing around in front of Archbellow. (low positive effect)
Kamautail can't believe how talented Curryfoot is! (high positive effect)
Kamautail and Tomatofreckle were heard discussing kits. (high positive effect)
Stoatshade appreciates Icyriver's helpful attitude. (low positive effect)
Stoatshade, Rollshock, and Hushshimmer had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Peatcrest squashes a bug that Stoatshade was watching. (medium negative effect)
Ochretail noticed Poolleaf is doing her best today. (low positive effect)
Ochretail invites Antlerkit, Stoatshade, Hollyheart, and Fluttershade to share what's been on their minds and to have an honest talk with each other. (positive effect)
Ochretail left a gift in Oddmuzzle's nest for him to find. (medium positive effect)
Ochretail's tail was badly injured by a dog.
Algaepool brings Saffronfoot a piece of fresh-kill after a long day of healing work. (medium positive effect)
Early in the morning, Algaepool rallies Bushberry, Voletuft, Carptail, and Fleadusk to do stretches in hopes of keeping his Clanmates prepared for anything. (negative effect)
Algaepool just told Reedheart a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Auburnsplash mews congratulations to Kamautail for a job well done. (low positive effect)
Auburnsplash, Saffronfoot, and Peatcrest had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Auburnsplash always has something good to say about Peakspore. (high positive effect)
Auburnsplash was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Peatcrest last night... (high positive effect)
During a patrol, Erminedaisy and Onemuzzle have a long conversation about their beliefs and agree on many things. (medium positive effect)
Erminedaisy and Heatherfern swap secrets with each other. (high positive effect)
Mosscrackle's words of comfort mean more to Pebblechase than she knows. (high positive effect)
Gentlepaw, Shimmerpaw, Dancingpaw, and Daisypaw are too busy goofing off to listen to Pebblechase's advice. (negative effect)
Pebblechase gives Riomane a circular Twoleg object he found, and hides behind his whiskers when thanked. (high positive effect)
Heatherfern doesn't think there's ever a dull moment with Mossflight. (high positive effect)
Dancingscreech guides Heatherfern to someone she is looking for. (low positive effect)
Mallowpelt says something vulnerable to Riomane. (low positive effect)
Riomane is told about Auburnsplash's bravery during a recent time of struggle. (medium positive effect)
Gracklefur says something vulnerable to Fidgetmouse. (low positive effect)
The moonlight encourages Fidgetmouse, Harefeather, Paellapad, Prancelaurel, and Carptail to slow down and stretch. (positive effect)
Fidgetmouse asks Fluttershade to look at a little cut on her leg. (high positive effect)
Archbellow no longer has a running nose.
Archbellow and Amberfur often look at each other and smile knowingly about something. (low positive effect)
Archbellow and Fluttershade always challenge one another. (high positive effect)
Nightglow has recovered from his sprain.
Nightglow gets excellent advice from Skulkwillow about something he had been worrying about. (high positive effect)
Nightglow was flattered by Pigeonbloom's politeness this morning. (low positive effect)
Cobaltstrike compliments Petalglow on her bravery today. (medium positive effect)
Cobaltstrike and Ochretail share little secrets about themselves. (medium positive effect)
Mallardfeather can't help but smile seeing Pearpelt smile. (low positive effect)
Mallardfeather gets some good advice from Fidgetmouse about something trivial. (low positive effect)
Pigeonbloom admires Skiphare's dedication. (medium positive effect)
Pigeonbloom and Suntooth take a nap together. (low positive effect)
Hailfreckle vents about something trivial to Bitterleaf. (low positive effect)
Bitterleaf nearly tripped, but was caught by Reedheart. (medium positive effect)
Archbellow tells a Clanmate that Harefeather did a great job today. (medium positive effect)
Harefeather recruits Fluttershade, Heatherfern, Bouncepelt, and Bitebone to tidy up camp upon noticing how unorganized it has become. (negative effect)
Harefeather thought Peatcrest was polite today. (low positive effect)
Paellapad saw Petalglow hide something before talking to her. (low negative effect)
Shimmerpaw, Daisypaw, Gentlepaw, and Dancingpaw bemoan Paellapad's insistence that they get up and do stretches at dawn. While they do it, nobody but Paellapad likes it. (negative effect)
Pearpelt is telling Paellapad in great detail how they would protect her from any danger. (medium positive effect)
Paellapad saved Pearpelt from a big dog, but was badly injured.
A Clanmate accuses Dancingscreech of copying one of Pearpelt's jokes. (medium negative effect)
Dancingscreech always takes food to Bitebone. (medium positive effect)
Talonlake helps Fluttershade pick burrs out of her fur. (medium positive effect)
Fluttershade fell asleep when she was supposed to be guarding camp.
Gracklefur's small cut has healed up nicely.
Icyriver helps Gracklefur get a thorn out of his paw. (low positive effect)
Late into the evening, Gracklefur invites Warmswirl, Tomatofreckle, Hollyheart, and Primfreckle to stretch with him and enjoy each other's company. (positive effect)
Gracklefur shares a joke about a neighboring Clan with Bouncepelt. (low positive effect)
Gracklefur is sick with whitecough.
During a hunting patrol, Peakspore and Dancingscreech share a piece of prey that is too small to bring back to camp. (medium positive effect)
While Peakspore and Dancingscreech are talking, Peakspore gets the feeling that he can trust Dancingscreech, and confesses that he likes Skulkwillow. (positive effect)
Prancelaurel reminds Peakspore to grab something from the fresh-kill pile if she hasn't already. (medium positive effect)
Bitebone backs up one of Skiphare's claims during one of Skiphare's arguments. (high positive effect)
The moonlight encourages Bitebone, Auburnsplash, Elmtrail, Heavythud, and Primfreckle to slow down and stretch. (positive effect)
Bouncepelt thinks very often about Snakedrop. (high positive effect)
Carptail does something that makes Bouncepelt's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
Snippool keeps avoiding eye contact with Burrweb. (medium negative effect)
Burrweb, wanting to help keep his Clanmates in shape and ready for anything, wakes Stoatshade, Suntooth, Peakspore, and Bitterleaf up early for morning stretches. (negative effect)
Burrweb hears a nice story about Bitebone. (low positive effect)
Stoatshade has a fight with Suntooth about what's right. (medium negative effect)
Pearpelt is inspired by Mallardfeather's passion. (medium positive effect)
Pearpelt, Bitterleaf, and Primfreckle took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Diablofoot calls out the Clan for targeting Pearpelt. (high positive effect)
In the middle of a conversation, Quailfur and Kokomi realize they have less in common than they thought. (medium negative effect)
Quailfur, Suntooth, and Bitterleaf had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Quailfur and Dancingscreech heckled another Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Diablofoot includes Gardeniaglow in a conversation that Gardeniaglow struggled to join. (low positive effect)
Diablofoot notices how Paellapad is being helpful around camp. (medium positive effect)
Reedheart sees that Cobaltstrike's piece of prey looks tastier and asks if he'd like to swap. He agrees happily, saying he likes that one better. (low positive effect)
Reedheart and Algaepool defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Reedheart purrs for a long time at one of Pearpelt's lame jokes. (high positive effect)
Reedheart has gotten yellowcough.
Freezefoot wonders if she can ever be as good as Bushberry. (medium positive effect)
Fringesnap's advice is more helpful than Freezefoot expected. (medium positive effect)

At the Gathering, VoleClan's leader announces their medicine cat has been exiled for a terrible transgression. They warn the other Clans that the exiled cat is not to be trusted and should be killed on sight.
Snippool has healed from the strain of delivering her litter.
Whenever Duckbelly's name is mentioned, Snippool relaxes. (high positive effect)
Shimmerpaw, Gentlepaw, Dancingpaw, and Daisypaw bemoan Snippool's insistence that they get up and do stretches at dawn. While they do it, nobody but Snippool likes it. (negative effect)
Hollyheart points out to Snippool that a spider is in her nest before she sits in it. (low positive effect)
Gardeniaglow and Olivebranch defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Gardeniaglow greets Kokomi as she's exiting the warriors' den. (medium positive effect)
Mossflight thought Cobaltstrike was polite today. (low positive effect)
The moonlight encourages Mossflight, Diablofoot, Elmtrail, Pearpelt, and Fluttershade to slow down and stretch. (positive effect)
Mossflight heard a story about something kind Skulkwillow did. (low positive effect)
Murkhaven won't back down when defending Hushshimmer on something. (high positive effect)
Hushshimmer, Skulkwillow, and Voletuft had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Amberfur respects Hushshimmer's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Mallardfeather thanked Warmswirl for bringing her food. (low positive effect)
Warmswirl and Kokomi make an elaborate plan to evict a predator from the Clan's territory. (medium positive effect)
Shardtail tries to groom their pelt the same way Bouncepelt does. (medium positive effect)
Shardtail and Mossflight talk about what they see in the clouds. (low positive effect)
Shardtail's belly has been upset all day.
Kokomi is sharing tongues with Kamautail. (high positive effect)
Stretching might be good for one's health, but Shimmerpaw, Gentlepaw, Dancingpaw, and Daisypaw wish Kokomi didn't insist on stretching at the crack of dawn. (negative effect)
Freezefoot didn't put a lot of thought into an answer for Kokomi's question. (low negative effect)
Kokomi wasn't looking where she was going and tripped over a small stump, but came out of it with only her pride bruised.
Amberfur saw Onemuzzle show off a skill he never knew they had. (high positive effect)
Amberfur appreciates Cobaltstrike, Skulkwillow, Fringesnap, and Primfreckle joining him to stretch late into the night so he wouldn't be alone. (positive effect)
Talonlake saves the funniest jokes for Amberfur. (medium positive effect)
Fringesnap likes something Rollshock has, so Rollshock tells him to keep it. (medium positive effect)
Fringesnap asks Warmswirl about a lie Warmswirl told, but he dodges the question. (medium negative effect)
Verbenabloom turned to Rollshock in a time of need, only for Rollshock to abandon her. (high negative effect)
Verbenabloom finds an old seagull nest while out hunting. It seems to be long abandoned, but some pretty feathers have remained intact! Verbenabloom decides to take some with her.
Some things have been rough for Cobaltstrike lately, but Fleadusk admires his willingness to go on. (medium positive effect)
Fleadusk, Shinefur, and Amberfur had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Fleadusk scolds Hollyheart about something she did, but Hollyheart doesn't take him seriously. (high negative effect)
Bushberry's words of comfort mean more to Skulkwillow than he knows. (high positive effect)
Murkhaven just told Shimmerpaw a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Murkhaven charms Poolleaf with endless compliments. (medium positive effect)
Icyriver's whitecough is gone.
Icyriver finds a bit of fluff that smells like Burrweb and adds it to her nest. (low positive effect)
Icyriver goes to Heavythud to ask for his wisdom. (medium positive effect)
Fleadusk does something that makes Elmtrail's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
Elmtrail talks with Mallowpelt about some Clan drama. (low positive effect)
Brindletooth sees the skill with which Heavythud heals a Clanmate. (medium positive effect)
Brindletooth notices that Verbenabloom is always one of the first to volunteer for a difficult task. (medium positive effect)
Sardinespeckle and Skulkwillow mark the same spot of the border as a sign of friendship. Gross. (medium positive effect)
Riomane, Nightglow, Petalglow, and Archbellow talk about Sardinespeckle's combat prowess during a skirmish. (positive effect)
Poolleaf won't stop looking at a specific Clanmate while talking to Sardinespeckle. (low negative effect)
Shinefur and Bouncepelt defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Shinefur tells Heavythud a deep, dark secret. (high positive effect)
Talonlake asked Gardeniaglow for his opinion on a topic and had a surprisingly insightful conversation. (high positive effect)
Talonlake, Flightsplash, and Curryfoot had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Talonlake is asking Mallowpelt interesting questions. (low positive effect)
Peakspore tells Frondpad that her pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Talonlake's laugh reminds Frondpad of someone she misses. (low positive effect)
Poolleaf and Freezefoot sunbathe together. (low positive effect)
Poolleaf, Elmtrail, and Yewstar had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Pheasantbrush swears that Paellapad's fangs are longer than usual. (medium negative effect)
Mallowpelt feels comfortable challenging Bitebone on something he said. (high positive effect)
Mallowpelt was attacked by a group of rats! He managed to fight them off, but didn't escape unscathed.
Onemuzzle stretched in front of Duckbelly. Duckbelly didn't get a great view. (low negative effect)
Onemuzzle recruits Daisypaw, Dancingpaw, Shimmerpaw, and Gentlepaw to tidy up camp upon noticing how unorganized it has become. (negative effect)
Onemuzzle sees Voletuft whispering suspiciously to a Clanmate. (low negative effect)
Voletuft had a difficult conversation with Rollshock, and they both ended up resentful of one another. (high negative effect)
Flightsplash no longer has a stomachache.
Peatcrest keeps making excuses about something Flightsplash wants to know. (medium negative effect)
Mallardfeather gave Skiphare a gift that doesn't make sense. (medium negative effect)
When Skiphare tells Voletuft about a goal he has, Voletuft snickers at it. (low negative effect)
Hailfreckle overhears Freezefoot educating Clanmates about their fallen ancestors. (high positive effect)
Hailfreckle, Suntooth, and Frondpad had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Hailfreckle is sick with yellowcough.
Saltpaw says something in passing that Rollshock keeps getting worked up about. (low negative effect)
Snakedrop's dislocated joint has been popped back into place and is feeling much better.
Dancingscreech compliments Snakedrop's name. (low positive effect)
Shimmerpaw, Dancingpaw, Gentlepaw, and Daisypaw are too busy goofing off to listen to Snakedrop's advice. (negative effect)

Shimmerpaw barely seems to be paying attention, focused instead on a fluttering leaf. Yewstar has to repeat her name a few times before she finally pays attention long enough to give her vow. Sighing, the leader names her Shimmerrunner after her humor.
Shimmerrunner sees a Clanmate complimenting Heavythud and feels a pang of envy. (low negative effect)

His training is done already? Dancingpaw isn't entirely sure if he's quite as ready to be a warrior as the leader claims him to be. His voice trembles when he takes his vow. As he's renamed to Dancingfleck, in honor of his strategy, he can't help but wonder if that is truly something that describes him.
Dancingfleck thinks about telling others that Flightsplash broke the Code. (high negative effect)
Dancingfleck wasn't looking where he was going and tripped over a small stump, gaining a few bruises.
Daisypaw overheard Yewstar spreading a hurtful rumor. (high negative effect)
Gentlepaw tells himself that he can't let these feelings consume him. He has to learn to live with it.
Gentlepaw swears that Sardinespeckle stole something from his nest. (high negative effect)
Petalglow has recovered from whitecough.
Primfreckle tells Petalglow that her pelt is shiny today. (low positive effect)
Craneflight points out that Petalglow's fresh-kill has gone bad before she eats it. (medium positive effect)
Petalglow fell from a cliff and somehow survived, though not without breaking her leg.
Petalglow is sick with whitecough.
Mosscrackle protects Curryfoot from something on a patrol. (medium positive effect)
When Mosscrackle gets a little hurt, Craneflight giggles before asking if she's okay. (low negative effect)
Bushberry realizes that a strange smell in camp is coming from Fluttershade. (medium negative effect)
Bushberry is amazed at how skilled Cobaltstrike really is. (high positive effect)
Bushberry watches Duckbelly give an elder the best piece of prey on the pile. He feels lucky to have such a kind cat as his mate.
Antlerkit reassures Erminedaisy about something that was bothering him. (low positive effect)
